name: 04330 · Augusta, ME
findings: ZIP 04330 (Augusta) has 237 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04330 (Augusta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
